# 99Trace

> 99Trace: Easy Integration with PostHog for WooCommerce is a free, open-source (GPL-2.0-or-later) WordPress plugin by 99Ways. It sends every WooCommerce order to PostHog exactly once, on the visitor who placed it: the shop's server sends purchases, refunds and cancellations, so payment redirects, in-app browsers and ad blockers no longer lose orders, and posthog-js and the server share one first-party visitor ID.

- Requirements: WordPress 6.5+, WooCommerce 8.7+, PHP 8.0+, and a PostHog project (PostHog Cloud EU or US, or self-hosted).
- Server events: Order Completed (once, at the payment time, under the identity saved at checkout), Order Refunded, Order Cancelled, Payment Failed, Checkout Started, Product Added, Product Removed, Coupon Applied, Coupon Removed.
- Exactly once: each order event carries a UUID derived from the order, so retries are duplicates PostHog drops.
- Optional browser module: runs posthog-js (page views, autocapture, heatmaps, web vitals, replay, surveys, error tracking).
- Consent: track every visitor, or follow Cookiebot or the WP Consent API.
- Not affiliated with PostHog Inc. or with WooCommerce and Automattic.
